_help: Weapon perks. 'effect' selects the code path in scripts/gear/perk_system.gd; the other fields are its parameters. 'glyph' + 'icon_color' draw the perk badge in the UI. 'playstyle': true marks perks that change how you play (detonating hits, kill-reload rhythm, grenade loop, kill sustain, crouch/slide fighting) as opposed to plain on-kill stat buffs (false); the Merchant guarantees at least one playstyle perk on Legendary / Mythic offers (data/merchant.json playstyle_perks_min). 'signature': true = a Mythic-only signature perk: never in random rolls (GearDB.roll_weapon skips it, MAIN_HOOKS §19c); the Merchant gives each Mythic offer one (data/merchant.json mythic_signature_perks). Signatures reuse stateless effect paths, so they stack safely with pool perks.
